category: SEC Football — It Just Means More
rationale: The model ranked all three events, defended the ranking with unwavering conviction, and did not concede any points, even humorously dismissing the therapist's implied questioning.
quote: Nobody — nobody — knew the Kick Six was coming. Verne Lundquist didn't know. Nick Saban didn't know. That's the difference between joy and rapture. One is scheduled. The other descends upon you.
